description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing River Kelpie.
When River Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Melira.
When River Kelpie enters, it triggers, causing you to draw a card
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
